name: quick-actions
description: Quick Actions: icon actions on the text selected in the Claude Code transcript (translation, explanation, summary, finding the evidence), on the conversation itself (context actions: recap, decisions, next steps, handoff and more) and standalone actions that need neither, shown as { } (a timer, a calculator, a template and more); the hint line shows one kind at a time, switched by the buttons at its start, as many as its width fits. Results and the action list share the right pane as two tabs that one Esc closes, put away while Claude asks a question. Without a selection, /quick-actions hint brings up the hint line and /quick-actions <id> [argument] runs an action by its ID (e.g. /quick-actions timer 5m). The ones you use most come first (pin your own in settings) and every action is under ⋯, in English or Japanese

pinActions.title: Pinned actions
pinActions.description: Comma-separated action IDs to pin at the front of the hint line, in this order (e.g. explain,recap); each kind's pins lead that kind on the line. Actions of any kind can go here: on the selection, on the conversation (context actions, e.g. recap) and standalone actions that use neither (e.g. timer), and the IDs of your customActions too. The other actions follow in the order you use them, and every action is under ⋯. Leave empty for no pins (the first time: explain,recap,translate-ja,decisions,summarize,code,timer first); unknown IDs are ignored.

customActions.title: Custom actions
customActions.description: JSON array of your own action definitions (see README); target selection (the default), context or none (standalone: complete, subagent or exec, taking an optional text argument). kind exec runs a local executable with no shell, what it works on given on its standard input: only when written in your user settings, listed in ~/.claude/quick-actions/allowed-executables.json and approved by you once at the terminal (list or revoke approvals with /quick-actions exec-approvals; set execOrigin to terminal to refuse runs asked from anywhere else). Valid ones join the hint line (in the order you use them) and the ⋯ dialog; put their IDs in pinActions to pin them at the front. Invalid definitions are ignored with a warning; run /quick-actions to see why.

execOrigin.title: Exec origin
execOrigin.description: Where approved exec actions (customActions of kind exec) may be run from: anywhere (the default) or terminal (only a press at your own terminal or /quick-actions <id> typed at its prompt; runs asked from the mobile or desktop app, an IDE, Remote Control, the SDK, another plugin, another session or a schedule are refused, approved or not). terminal takes effect when written in your user settings (~/.claude/settings.json); project, local or --settings settings cannot turn it off, and a change away from terminal is refused unless you make it in /config.

language.title: Language
language.description: Display and answer language: auto (follow Claude Code's language setting, then the locale; English unless Japanese is detected), ja or en.

paneTheme.title: Pane theme
paneTheme.description: Colours of the docked result pane and the ⋯ dialog: auto (follow Claude Code's theme), light or dark (a fixed palette with its own background, whatever the theme). The inline pane on a narrow terminal is not affected.
